SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(telescope_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share_pct) as avg_share_pct,
  AVG(share_pct) - (SELECT AVG(100.0 * COUNT(*) / 949) FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) as avg_excess_over_avg
FROM (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, 100.0 * COUNT(*) / 949 as share_pct 
  FROM telescopes 
  GROUP BY observstation 
  HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(*) / 949 > (SELECT AVG(100.0 * COUNT(*) / 949) FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation)
)
